description: This file defines a helper module, TokenStorage, for managing authentication tokens in browser localStorage. It provides functions to get, set, and clear the token, with checks for server-side rendering contexts.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the token from localStorage if running in a browser environment.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores the provided token in localStorage if running in a browser environment.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the token from localStorage if running in a browser environment.
